reviews.name: Bilal Mohammed
reviews.text:
I’m disappointed with the way this mosque has been planned and managed. Millions of dollars have gone into building a large, beautifully decorated facility, yet there doesn’t seem to be adequate space or resources for families such as a dedicated children’s room, bookstore, or library.
Parking is also a major concern. The parking lot does not seem large enough, and people often end up trying to park near the surrounding apartment complexes, which can create inconvenience for residents.

What concerns me most is the experience for families with children. Parents sometimes feel discouraged or criticized for bringing their kids. If families and children are not welcomed, it raises the question of what purpose such a large facility is ultimately serving.

The women’s entrance is another issue. Although there is a designated ladies’ entrance, it is often closed, leaving women to enter and exit through the main entrance used by men. That seems unnecessary and could be addressed with better planning and management.

A mosque should be more than an impressive building. It should be a welcoming community space for families, children, women, and everyone who comes to worship. I hope the leadership will focus more on serving the community and addressing these practical concerns rather than simply taking pride in having a large mosque in Indiana.

زيارة رائعة لمسجد جميل جداً في قرية هادئة، بعيد عن صخب المدينة.
المسجد نظيف للغاية، يشعرك بالراحة والطمأنينة من أول خطوة تدخل فيها. الجو هادئ ومريح، مثالي للصلاة والخشوع والتأمل. التصميم أنيق وبسيط في نفس الوقت، مع إضاءة مريحة وتهوية جيدة.
القرية المحيطة بها هادية تماماً، مما يضيف للتجربة روحانية أكبر. لا ضجيج، لا ازدحام، فقط سكينة وخشوع.
نصيحتي: لو تبحث عن مكان للصلاة أو الاعتكاف أو حتى زيارة هادئة، هذا المسجد خيار ممتاز.
جزاكم الله خيراً على هذا المكان الطيب، وبارك الله فيه وفي أهل القرية.
أنصح الجميع بزيارته! 🙏🕌
reviews.textTranslated:
A wonderful visit to a beautiful mosque in a quiet village, far from the hustle and bustle of the city.

The mosque is exceptionally clean, and you feel a sense of peace and tranquility from the moment you enter. The atmosphere is peaceful and relaxing, perfect for prayer, reflection, and contemplation. The design is elegant yet simple, with comfortable lighting and good ventilation.

The surrounding village is completely peaceful, adding to the spiritual experience. No noise, no crowds, just serenity and devotion.

My advice: If you're looking for a place to pray, retreat, or even just a quiet visit, this mosque is an excellent choice.

May God reward you for this wonderful place, and may He bless it and the people of the village.

I highly recommend everyone visit it! 🙏🕌
